definitionZh: 文本转换 CSS 属性指定如何利用元素的文本 。 它可以用来使文本出现在全大写或全小写中,或者每个单词都资本化. 也可以帮助提高红宝石的可视性.
sourceDefinition: The text-transform CSS property specifies how to capitalize an element's text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. It also can help improve legibility for ruby.
